text:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild for runtime nodes this weekend. KMS signer key rotation + RBAC tweaks are on the path. Anyone object to a Saturday 03:00 UTC canary? :calendar:
kevin: +1 for Saturday. Do we have the KMS role change diff ready? I want to make sure operator SA won't lose decrypt on startup.
jordan: Working on the role diff now. Plan is to split duties: signer-only SA for image signing, runtime-decrypt SA for node boot. That avoids giving signing perms broadly.
sara: Important: we must ensure audit logs capture image verification failures. Add a k8s-audit-policy rule to capture events from the node attestor webhook.
dave: Agreed. Also we should avoid changing ClusterRoleBindings at the last minute. Can we do a staged rollout? canary nodes -> all nodes.
maria: Yes — canary set of 3 nodes in us-east-1. If the KMS decrypt fails we revert the image reference to previous digest. Ops playbook has the revert command.
ops-bot: Reminder: run `./scripts/preflight-checks.sh` before the window. Failure will auto-abort cutover.
kevin: Jordan, paste the minimal IAM policy you plan to apply for the runtime-decrypt SA. Want to vouch for least privilege.
jordan: Sure — here's the policy (minimal):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
    }
  ]
}
```
sara: That looks fine. Add a Condition restricting to the runtime EKS role's principal-arn to prevent cross-use.
dave: For RBAC, create a namespaced Role that allows `get` on the `imageattestations` CRD and bind it to the runtime-decrypt SA. No cluster-wide privileges needed.
maria: Audit logging ops: we'll ship cluster audit to the secure logging account with `k8s_audit.image.verify` field set for easier search. @kevin can you add a Kibana saved query for that label?
kevin: Yup — I'll add a `k8s_audit.image.verify:error OR k8s_audit.image.verify:fail` saved search and alert threshold on >5 fails in 10m.
jordan: For the signing rotation: we'll rotate the cosign key in two phases: publish new public key to keyserver, sign images with new key for canary, then update runtime truststore if canary passes.
sara: Make sure timestamped SBOMs are produced and uploaded to the SBOM bucket before cutover. That will help vuln triage if anything odd comes up.
dave: Contingency: if a node fails to boot due to KMS errors, we'll cordon, drain, and attach the old image digest via the `--image-digest` field in the machine pool manifest. Ops will retain a warm capacity.
maria: Who's owning incident response if the canary triggers an image verification failure during the window? I volunteer to lead the triage for initial 2 hours.
kevin: I'll be backup and own the rollback command and RBAC revert if needed.
sara: I'll monitor audit stream and initial vuln scanner outputs. If we see repeated verification fails plus SBOM mismatches, escalate to Platform oncall.
ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2025-11-15T03:00:00Z -> 2025-11-15T06:00:00Z, canary ends at +30m. Preflight deadline: 2025-11-14T23:00:00Z.
jordan: One more: update Helm values to include the new runtime SA name and mount the KMS auth token via projected volume — no long-lived secrets.
maria: Notes: action items:
- jordan: open PR with IAM policy + K8s Role/RoleBinding (link in thread)
- kevin: Kibana saved query + rollback commands in runbook
- sara: ensure SBOM upload path and audit-policy diff
- dave: machine pool rollback steps and warm capacity check
- ops: preflight runs and smoke tests
Please post PR links and tag me when ready.
kevin: PRs posted: /pr/5432 (RBAC+IAM), /pr/5433 (audit-policy). I'll tag.
jordan: PR /pr/5432 is up. PTAL.
sara: Running preflight now — one minor lint on audit-policy; fixing.
dave: I've verified warm capacity in staging. No surprises.
maria: thanks all. If nothing shows up by 02:30 UTC we'll proceed. Otherwise we'll delay and re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
